data.title: Finding the Whole: Discounts, Tax, and Tips
data.description: Practice finding the original whole amount when given a partial value and its corresponding percentage in real-world pricing scenarios.

challenges.scenario: Sam has saved $30. That is 75% of the cost of a new bike.
challenges.question: Step 1 — the $30 is 75% of the whole. Mark 75% on the bar.

steps.prompt: Step 1 — the $30 is 75% of the whole. Mark 75% on the bar.
steps.hint: 75% means 75 out of every 100. Slide the bar to 75%.

steps.prompt: Step 2 — the whole bar is 100%. How much does the bike cost? Type the amount.
steps.hint: $30 is three quarters, so one quarter is $30 ÷ 3. The whole is four quarters.

challenges.hint: 75% means 75 out of every 100. Slide the bar to 75%.

challenges.scenario: Dana left a $5 tip. The tip was 25% of the bill.
challenges.question: Step 1 — the $5 is 25% of the whole. Mark 25% on the bar.

steps.prompt: Step 1 — the $5 is 25% of the whole. Mark 25% on the bar.
steps.hint: 25% means 25 out of every 100. Slide the bar to 25%.

steps.prompt: Step 2 — the whole bar is 100%. How much was the bill? Type the amount.
steps.hint: $5 is a quarter of the whole, and the whole is four quarters: $5 × 4.

challenges.hint: 25% means 25 out of every 100. Slide the bar to 25%.

challenges.scenario: A coupon took $30 off a jacket. The coupon was 40% off.
challenges.question: Step 1 — the $30 is 40% of the whole. Mark 40% on the bar.

steps.prompt: Step 1 — the $30 is 40% of the whole. Mark 40% on the bar.
steps.hint: 40% means 40 out of every 100. Slide the bar to 40%.

steps.prompt: Step 2 — the whole bar is 100%. What was the jacket's original price? Type the amount.
steps.hint: 40% is $30, so 10% is $30 ÷ 4. The whole is ten of those.

challenges.hint: 40% means 40 out of every 100. Slide the bar to 40%.

challenges.scenario: The sales tax on a speaker was $19. The tax rate is 10%.
challenges.question: Step 1 — the $19 is 10% of the whole. Mark 10% on the bar.

steps.prompt: Step 1 — the $19 is 10% of the whole. Mark 10% on the bar.
steps.hint: 10% means 10 out of every 100. Slide the bar to 10%.

steps.prompt: Step 2 — the whole bar is 100%. What was the speaker's price before tax? Type the amount.
steps.hint: $19 is one tenth of the whole, and the whole is ten tenths: $19 × 10.

challenges.hint: 10% means 10 out of every 100. Slide the bar to 10%.
